scientific.integrity: The first two silhouette-conditioned area moments are derived analytically for arbitrary tetrahedra from exact vertex-cone boundary integrals and independently checked numerically. Full relevant primary texts were compared for logical coverage. Numerical tests are diagnostic, not a universal proof. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Only full-dimensional Euclidean tetrahedra and uniform orthogonal projection directions.
Only first two conditional projected-area moments, not the complete conditional distributions.
Earlier work already determines the unweighted triangular-shadow probability and regular-tetrahedron unconditional area moments.
Possible unindexed older stereological equivalent is a historical originality risk.

title: Area-weighted silhouette probabilities of arbitrary tetrahedra
